Context: 11. T.A. on Retirement

- (ii) of re-employment.  
The expenditure for TA on joining such appointment shall be borne by the organization from where the pensioner is retired / superannuated with reference to the post held at the time of retirement. On completion of I  
term of re-employment, the TA would be reimbursed by the office organization where the pensioner is re-employed.
